description_en: Queries the user-configured result set export settings
description_zh: 获取用户配置的结果集导出信息
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-result-export-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-8vbf80pjcz00000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeResultExportConfig

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口可以查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The export type. Valid values:

SLS: Indicates that the export destination is SLS.
OSS: Indicates that the export destination is OSS
parameters.help_zh:
导出类型，枚举类型，当前可选值为：

SLS：标识导出目的为SLS。
OSS：标识导出目的为OSS
parameters.name: export_type

Code.description_en: API status or POP error code

ExportType.description_en:
The export type. Valid values:

SLS: Indicates that the export destination is SLS.
OSS: Indicates that the export destination is OSS
ExportType.description_zh:
导出类型，枚举类型，当前可选值为：

SLS：标识导出目的为SLS。
OSS：标识导出目的为OSS

OssInfo.description_en: The configured OSS export settings, returned when the export destination is OSS
OssInfo.description_zh: 导出类型为OSS时，对应的OSS信息

ExportBasePath.description_en: The path of the OSS bucket to which the result sets are exported
ExportBasePath.description_zh: 导出结果存储的OSS路径地址

ResourceGroup.description_en: The name of the resource group that runs the export SQL
ResourceGroup.description_zh: 导出SQL运行的资源组名称

ResultFileTtl.description_en: The expiration period (in days) for the OSS file. The returned value is between 1 and 30 days (inclusive)
ResultFileTtl.description_zh: Oss文件过期时间，单位为天，最小1天，最大30天

SlsInfo.description_en: The configured SLS export settings, returned when the export destination is SLS
SlsInfo.description_zh: 导出类型为SLS时，对应的SLS配置信息

LogstoreTtl.description_en: The expiration period (in days) for the temporary Logstore automatically created during result set export. The Logstore is automatically deleted after expiration. The returned value is between 1 and 30 days (inclusive)
LogstoreTtl.description_zh: 结果集导出临时生成的logstore的过期时间，单位为天，过期后自动删除。 最小1天，最大30天

ResourceGroup.description_en: The name of the resource group that runs the export SQL
ResourceGroup.description_zh: 导出SQL运行的资源组名称

SlsProject.description_en: The name of the SLS project

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP response status code. A value of 200 indicates that the request was successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP请求返回的响应状态码，200表示请求发送成功
